name: PublishHtmlReport
description: Attach a static HTML report folder to the run, for the Reports tab.
helpMarkDown: Zips the report folder and attaches it to the pipeline run. Open the run's **Reports** tab to view it.
author: axlsoft, LLC

inputs.name: reportDir
inputs.label: Report folder
inputs.helpMarkDown: Folder that contains the report, such as `playwright-report` or `coverage/lcov-report`. Relative paths are resolved from the default working directory.

inputs.name: name
inputs.label: Report name
inputs.helpMarkDown: Name shown in the Reports tab. Use a different name for each report attached by the same job.

inputs.name: entry
inputs.label: Entry page
inputs.helpMarkDown: Page to open first, relative to the report folder.

inputs.name: ifMissing
inputs.label: If the report folder is missing
inputs.helpMarkDown: What to do when the report folder doesn't exist or has no files, for example because an earlier step failed before writing it.
